attchmntText: Davangere Sugar Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Davangere Sugar Company Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 7,161.35 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 10,632.91 Lakhs for the half year. The company reported a loss after tax of Rs. 632.57 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 538.73 Lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were negative Rs. 0.044 for the quarter and negative Rs. 0.038 for the half year. Statutory auditors issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were found. The results are available on the company website.
